title: Hafa Adai, Join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 317-38 (COR). Legislative Certificate 317-38 (COR) will be presented to the Vietnam Veterans of America, Chapter #668, in recognition of their commitment to honoring the profound legacy of our military veterans, their dedication, sacrifice, and service to our nation in observance of National Vietnam War Veterans Day on March 29, 2026, and to commend them for all they do in strengthening our community.
